description: Bounded public scholarly author directory and publication affiliation years, with explicit ORCID and ROR crosswalks

sampling.criteria: First response page of five public author records with ORCID requested, sorted by citation count requested. Provider response order is preserved; no representativeness or ordering guarantee.

coverage.scope: Five selected public author records and publication affiliation years, not global academia or employment history

access.probe: HTTP 200 on 2026-09-15; bounded prefix read, not a retained acquisition
access.credentials: No credentials required by verified endpoint probe; access policies may change

normalization.raw_fields: source_row on person; source_term or source_affiliation on role; all claims retain raw line evidence
normalization.identity: Only published identifier crosswalks; names are aliases, never merge evidence
normalization.temporal_scope: Separate publication affiliation years; no employment or continuous affiliation inferred
